Variables.CreateNewList List=> List
SET num TO 0
LOOP FOREACH CurrentItem IN List
    Variables.IncreaseVariable Value: num IncrementValue: 1
END
LOOP LoopIndex FROM 0 TO 10 STEP 2
    Variables.IncreaseVariable Value: num IncrementValue: 1
END
LOOP WHILE (num) <= (1000)
    Variables.IncreaseVariable Value: num IncrementValue: 77
END
LOOP WHILE (num) <= (1000)
    Variables.IncreaseVariable Value: num IncrementValue: 77
    NEXT LOOP
END
LOOP LoopIndex FROM 0 TO 10 STEP 2
    Variables.IncreaseVariable Value: num IncrementValue: 1
    EXIT LOOP
END
